## Task: Decompose 5 large proofs in psi_descent.v into per-case helper lemmas

### Background
A previous agent successfully decomposed these proofs and validated with `-vos`. The full compilation was at 19.5 GB after 1h12m (growing at 0.5 GB/min) — a huge improvement over the original 200+ GB. But the agent timed out before compilation finished and the worktree was cleaned up.

Your job: recreate the decomposition and commit the result. Do NOT wait for full compilation — just validate with `-vos` and commit.

### File location
`/scratch/lelarge/mathcomp-eulerian/psi_descent.v` (1858 lines, already has `abstract` on `has_left_child_cons` and `#[global] Opaque` on major lemmas)

### What to decompose
The 5 proofs that use `elim=> [|n IH] ... case: (ltngtP i j)` pattern:

1. `post_window_extremum` (~150 lines)
2. `pre_window_lt_max_when_min_head` (~96 lines)  
3. `pre_window_gt_min_when_max_head` (~92 lines)
4. `exactly_one_descent_LR` (~130 lines)
5. `pre_window_extremum_R` (~150 lines)

### Decomposition pattern
For each proof, extract the 3 case branches (i<j, i>j, i=j) as separate `Local Lemma`s. The branch lemma takes the induction hypothesis IH as a parameter plus the common hypotheses.

Example for `post_window_extremum`:
```
Local Lemma post_window_extremum_lt n
  (IH : forall i w, size w <= n -> uniq w -> 
    i + window_size i w < size w ->
    (nth 0 w (i + window_size i w) < nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) 0) \/
    (nth 0 w (i + window_size i w) > nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) (window_size i w).-1))
  i a s0
  (Hsz : size s0 <= n) (Hu : uniq (a :: s0))
  (Hpost : i + window_size i (a :: s0) < size (a :: s0))
  (Hij : i < mm_pos (a :: s0)) :
  (* goal matching the case branch *)
  ...
Proof.
(* copy the i < j branch proof verbatim, adjusting for the new context *)
Qed.
```

Then the main proof becomes:
```
Lemma post_window_extremum i w : ...
Proof.
...
elim=> [|n IH] i w Hsz Hu Hpost.
  (* base case *)
case: w Hsz Hu Hpost => [//|a s0] Hsz Hu Hpost.
...
case: (ltngtP i j) => [Hij | Hji | Heq_ij].
- exact: post_window_extremum_lt IH ...
- exact: post_window_extremum_gt IH ...
- exact: post_window_extremum_eq ...
Qed.
```

### Important
- Read the current file first to understand the exact proof structure
- For each proof, understand what hypotheses each branch needs
- The branch lemma statements must match the goal after the case split
- Some branches have SUB-cases (e.g., post_window_extremum's i<j case has two sub-cases for i+ws<j and i+ws=j). That's fine — put them all in the branch lemma.
- Use `Local Lemma` so they don't export
- Validate with `rocq compile -vos -q -w -deprecated-library-file -w -notation-overridden -R . mathcomp_eulerian psi_descent.v` after each decomposition
- After ALL 5 are decomposed and -vos passes, commit the result
- Do NOT wait for full `rocq compile` — just commit and exit

### Approach
1. Start with the simplest/smallest proof first to establish the pattern
2. For each proof, the statement of the branch lemma needs to be inferred from the goal state after the case split — be careful with the window_at/window_size rewrites that happen between common setup and the case split
3. If a branch lemma is hard to state, you can use a more general statement and specialize in the main proof

### Constraint
Work quickly — focus on getting -vos to pass and committing. Don't spend time on full compilation.

27	(* ----- M4.1 Tree classifier: has_left_child -------------------------------- *)
28	(* Vertex i has a left child iff i > 0 at its recursive level, i.e.,          *)
29	(* mm_pos of the containing subarray is strictly to the right of the          *)
30	(* subarray's left boundary. Mirrors window_size_fuel's recursion.            *)

35	Fixpoint has_left_child_fuel (fuel : nat) (i : nat) (s : seq nat) : bool :=
36	  match fuel with
37	  | 0 => false
38	  | fuel'.+1 =>
39	      match s with
40	      | [::] => false
41	      | _ :: _ =>
42	          let j := mm_pos s in
43	          if i < j then has_left_child_fuel fuel' i (take j s)
44	          else if i == j then (0 < j)
45	          else has_left_child_fuel fuel' (i - j - 1) (drop j.+1 s)
46	      end
47	  end.

50	  has_left_child_fuel (size w) i w.

55	  has_left_child_fuel fuel 0 s = false.

66	  size s <= fuel1 -> fuel1 <= fuel2 ->
67	  has_left_child_fuel fuel2 i s = has_left_child_fuel fuel1 i s.

70	  move: Hsz1; rewrite leqn0 => /nilP ->.
71	  by case: f2 Hle.
72	case: f2 Hle => // f2 Hle.
73	case: s Hsz1 => [// | a s0 Hsz1] /=.
74	set s := a :: s0.
75	have Hj : mm_pos s < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.

77	have Hj2 : j <= size s0 by rewrite -ltnS.

93	(* preventing the kernel from inlining the proof term into downstream Qeds.  *)

96	  let s := a :: s0 in
97	  let j := mm_pos s in

99	    if i < j then has_left_child i (take j s)
100	    else if i == j then (0 < j)

142	(* The element just after the window is an ancestor's extremum, hence either  *)
143	(* less than min(window) or greater than max(window). Since rank_shift only  *)
144	(* permutes the window values, the descent bit at the right boundary is      *)

148	Local Lemma post_win_ext_lt n
149	  (IH : forall i w, size w <= n ->
150	    uniq w -> i + window_size i w < size w ->
151	    (nth 0 w (i + window_size i w)
152	       < nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) 0) \/
153	    (nth 0 w (i + window_size i w)
154	       > nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w))
155	               (window_size i w).-1))
156	  i a s0
157	  (Hsz : size s0 <= n)
158	  (Huniq : uniq (a :: s0))
159	  (Hpost : i + window_size i (a :: s0) <
160	           size (a :: s0))
161	  (Hij : i < mm_pos (a :: s0)) :
162	  (nth 0 (a :: s0)
163	     (i + window_size i (a :: s0))
164	   < nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i (a :: s0))) 0) \/
165	  (nth 0 (a :: s0)
166	     (i + window_size i (a :: s0))
167	   > nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i (a :: s0)))
168	           (window_size i (a :: s0)).-1).

170	set s := a :: s0; set j := mm_pos s.
171	have Hj : j < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
172	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by discriminate.
173	have Hfit := window_fits_left Hs_ne Hij.
174	have Htake_sz : size (take j s) = j

176	have Huniq_t : uniq (take j s).

178	    by rewrite cat_take_drop.
179	  by rewrite cat_uniq => /andP [? _].

181	  -/j Hij.

183	have Hws_eq : window_size i s = ws_t
184	  by rewrite (window_size_cons i a s0) -/j Hij.
185	case Hbnd : (i + ws_t < j).
186	- have Hpost_t : i + ws_t < size (take j s)
187	    by rewrite Htake_sz.
188	  have Hsz_t : size (take j s) <= n.
189	    rewrite Htake_sz; apply: leq_trans _ Hsz.
190	    by rewrite -ltnS /s /=.
191	  have := IH i (take j s) Hsz_t Huniq_t Hpost_t.
192	  by rewrite nth_take.
193	- have Hfit2 : i + ws_t = j.
194	    move/negbT: Hbnd; rewrite -leqNgt => Hge.
195	    have : i + window_size i s <= j := Hfit.
196	    by rewrite Hws_eq => Hfit';
197	       apply/eqP; rewrite eqn_leq Hge Hfit'.
198	  rewrite Hfit2.
199	  have Hnth_j := nth_w_mm_pos Hs_ne.

200	  set wa := window_at i (take j s).
201	  have Hws_t_gt0 : 0 < ws_t.
202	    by apply: window_size_gt0; rewrite Htake_sz.
203	  have Hwa_sz : size wa = ws_t.
204	    rewrite /wa /window_at.
205	    apply: size_takel.
206	    have := window_size_bound i (take j s).
207	    by rewrite size_drop Htake_sz.
208	  have Hwa_ne : wa <> [::].
209	    by move=> Habs; rewrite Habs /= in Hwa_sz;
210	       move: Hws_t_gt0; rewrite -Hwa_sz.
211	  have Hwa_sub : {subset wa <= take j s}.
212	    move=> x; rewrite /wa /window_at => Hx.
213	    have H1 := mem_take Hx.
214	    exact: mem_drop H1.
215	  set minv := foldr minn (head 0 s) (behead s).
216	  set maxv := foldr maxn (head 0 s) (behead s).

219	  have Hmax_sort := max_eq_nth_sort_last Hwa_ne.

221	  + left; rewrite Hval -Hmin_sort.
222	    set minwa := foldr minn (head 0 wa) (behead wa).
223	    have Hminwa_in : minwa \in wa.
224	      rewrite /minwa; case: (wa) Hwa_ne => [//|b t] _ /=.
225	      exact: min_in.

227	      apply: foldr_minn_le.

229	      exact: mem_take.

242	      apply: foldr_maxn_ge.
243	      have := Hwa_sub _ Hmaxwa_in.
244	      exact: mem_take.
245	    have Hmaxwa_ne : maxwa != maxv.
246	      apply/negP => /eqP Heq_v.
247	      have : maxv \in take j s
248	        by rewrite -Heq_v; apply: Hwa_sub.
249	      by rewrite (negbTE Hno_max).
250	    have Hmaxwa_eq : nth 0 (sort leq wa) (ws_t.-1) = maxwa.
251	      have -> : ws_t.-1 = (size wa).-1
252	        by rewrite Hwa_sz.
253	      by rewrite -Hmax_sort.
254	    rewrite Hval Hmaxwa_eq.
255	    by rewrite ltn_neqAle Hmaxwa_ne Hmaxwa_le.

258	Local Lemma post_win_ext_gt n
259	  (IH : forall i w, size w <= n ->
260	    uniq w -> i + window_size i w < size w ->
261	    (nth 0 w (i + window_size i w)
262	       < nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) 0) \/
263	    (nth 0 w (i + window_size i w)
264	       > nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w))
265	               (window_size i w).-1))

267	  (Hsz : size s0 <= n)
268	  (Huniq : uniq (a :: s0))
269	  (Hpost : i + window_size i (a :: s0) <
270	           size (a :: s0))
271	  (Hji : mm_pos (a :: s0) < i) :
272	  (nth 0 (a :: s0)

276	     (i + window_size i (a :: s0))

282	set i' := i - j - 1.
283	set ds := drop j.+1 s.

297	    by rewrite ltn_add2r.
298	  rewrite Hds_sz subnK; last exact: Hj.
299	  rewrite -Hws_eq /i' -subnDA addn1.
300	  by rewrite addnAC subnK.
301	have Hsz_d : size ds <= n.
302	  rewrite Hds_sz /s /= subSS.
303	  exact: leq_trans (leq_subr j _) Hsz.
304	have := IH i' ds Hsz_d Huniq_d Hpost_d.
305	set ws' := window_size i' ds.
306	have Hnth_eq : nth 0 s (i + ws') = nth 0 ds (i' + ws').
307	  rewrite /ds nth_drop addnA [j.+1 + i']addnC Hi'_eq.
308	  by [].
309	have Hij_f : i < j = false by rewrite ltnNge (ltnW Hji).
310	have Heq_f : (i == j) = false by apply: gtn_eqF.
311	rewrite (window_at_cons i a s0) (window_size_cons i a s0)
